audience: course creators and training teams that enroll learners and track orders on a Thinkific site

useCases.title: Review courses and their enrollments
useCases.text: List the courses of the site and open one to read its status and description. List the enrollments of a course with progress and expiry.

useCases.title: Check one learner's progress
useCases.text: Find the learner by email, then list their enrollments. Open one enrollment to see its activation and expiry dates and percent completed.

useCases.title: Review the orders of a learner
useCases.text: Find the learner, list their orders, and open one order to see its items, amounts, currency and status.

useCases.title: Enroll a learner in a course
useCases.text: Get the learner and course IDs, then enroll the learner. Enrollment gives access and can send Thinkific's enrollment emails.

useCases.title: Create a learner account
useCases.text: Check that the email address is not in use yet, then create the learner account. Thinkific may send a welcome email.
